description: Record verify_snapshot verdicts using each entry’s kind and reviewToken. Missing tokens request a fresh review; changed or deleted entries return conflicts without being stamped. Entries judged ok are stamped verifiedAt; failures are flagged verificationFailed with your note and surface in get_context, get_snapshot, and mason_check_drift until corrected. Verdict notes are required for failures.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

kind.description: Entry kind returned by verify_snapshot; required to record a verdict

note.description: One line on what's wrong — required when ok is false

reviewToken.description: Copy the reviewToken from verify_snapshot after inspecting its evidence; required to record a verdict

verdicts.description: Entry name → verdict, exactly as returned by verify_snapshot

name: save_verification
